<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex703-2024-10-04-16-32" status="unreviewed"> 
            <milestone n="1. mkhyen gsum sde gnyis la khyad par yod par 'dod pa dgag pa" unit="section"/>
         dang po ni <rs type="person" ref="db:4593" ana="corpusmd:named_reference"><expan>slob dpon</expan> pa</rs><note type="editorial">Identification of "slob dpon pa" as Pa tshab nyi ma grags (ID:3868)unlikely</note> na re khyad par shin tu che ste mchod brjod ngag gi mkhyen gsum ni gang zag so so dang 'brel | rtogs tshul skye med rtogs tsam | byed pa so sor nges pa yin la | gcig shos ni gang zag gcig la yod | rtogs tshul mngon sum byed pa so sor ma nges pa'i phyir ro zhes gsungs pa 
         mi rigs te mkhyen gsum sde gnyis po chos can | gang zag rtogs tshul byed pa tha dad pa'i sgo nas dbyer med de| gang zag rtogs par byed pa gsum mtshungs pa'i phyir te 'di ltar skabs dang po gsum gyi mkhyen gsum yang 
          gang zag so so'i rgyud dang 'brel te| thub pa'i zhes pa dang | byang chub sems dpa' mkhas rnams kyi zhes pa dang | nyan thos la sogs zhes pas so || </seg></TEI>
